name: Camel Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Camel Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, recycling, and service of batteries in China and internationally. The company offers automotive AGM and EFB start-stop, automotive starter, and lithium-ion automotive start-stop batteries; commercial, industrial, residential, and portable energy storage products; heavy truck starter, flooded truck, and heavy truck AGM dual purpose batteries. It also provides gold cart and marine batteries; electric forklift batteries; lithium-ion heavy truck dual purpose and starter, lithium-ion RV, lithium-ion golf cart, and jump starter batteries; and car starter and heavy truck batteries.
